Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.

and"}, {"id": 139, "text": "10.5.4 \"interests in securities\" has the meaning given in and shall be construed in accordance with the Takeover Code from time to time."}, {"id": 140, "text": "11. NO REPRESENTATIONS; NO OFFER 11.1 You acknowledge that neither we nor any member of our Group nor our Representatives:"}, {"id": 143, "text": "11.1.1 accepts any responsibility for or makes any representation or warranty, express or implied, as to the truth, accuracy, completeness or reasonableness of any Confidential Information provided to you;"}, {"id": 144, "text": "11.1.2 will be liable to you or to any other person in respect of any Confidential Information provided to you or its use; or"}, {"id": 145, "text": "11.1.3 is obliged to update any Confidential Information provided to you or to notify you of or to correct any inaccuracies in any such information (even if such inaccuracies are discovered subsequent to the provision of such information)."}, {"id": 146, "text": "11.2 You agree that you will not place any reliance on any statement, representation, warranty or undertaking (written or oral or in any other form) made by us, any member of our Group or our Representatives in connection with the Confidential Information, any other Information provided to you, the Possible Transaction or any other matter contemplated hereby."}, {"id": 148, "text": "11.3 You acknowledge that you will be responsible for making your own decisions on the Confidential Information and the Possible Transaction."}, {"id": 150, "text": "11.4 You acknowledge and agree that neither the provision of any Confidential Information nor the discussions, negotiations or any other matter in relation to the Possible Transaction constitutes an offer, inducement or invitation to acquire any part of the JLT Group, nor will they form the basis of, or any representation in relation to, any agreement to acquire any part of the JLT Group."}, {"id": 152, "text": "11.5 Nothing in this paragraph 10 shall have the effect of limiting or restricting any liability arising as a result of fraud."}, {"id": 154, "text": "12.
